changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A sandbox serves a review or a conversation. A product feedback draft is one model call in the server (ADR 0097), so no sandbox has the action kind.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_sandbox DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_kind; ALTER TABLE agent_sandbox ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_kind CHECK (kind IN ('REVIEW', 'CONVERSATION'));
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE agent_sandbox DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_kind; ALTER TABLE agent_sandbox ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_kind CHECK (kind IN ('REVIEW', 'CONVERSATION', 'ACTION'));
